mapper.sql: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.paper_type, p.source_year, p.question_ids, p.question_count, p.batch_id, p.source_sha256, p.source_url, p.warning_count, p.warnings_json, p.create_time, p.update_time FROM paper p
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO paper (name, paper_type, source_year, question_ids, question_count, batch_id, source_sha256, source_url, warning_count, warnings_json) VALUES (#{name}, #{paperType}, #{sourceYear}, #{questionIds}, #{questionCount}, #{batchId}, #{sourceSha256}, #{sourceUrl}, #{warningCount}, #{warningsJson})
mapper.sql: SELECT q.id, q.question_type, q.subject_id, s.name AS subject_name, q.score, q.difficult, q.source_name, q.source_year, q.source_question_no, q.source_ref, q.stem_html, q.analysis_html, q.stem_text, q.correct, q.answer_text, q.status, q.status_reason, q.display_ready, q.license_tag, q.batch_id, b.batch_tag, q.assets_json, q.create_time, q.update_time FROM question q LEFT JOIN subject s ON s.id = q.subject_id LEFT JOIN import_batch b ON b.id = q.batch_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO question (question_type, subject_id, score, difficult, source_name, source_year, source_question_no, source_ref, stem_html, analysis_html, stem_text, correct, answer_text, status, status_reason, display_ready, license_tag, batch_id, assets_json) VALUES (#{questionType}, #{subjectId}, #{score}, #{difficult}, #{sourceName}, #{sourceYear}, #{sourceQuestionNo}, #{sourceRef}, #{stemHtml}, #{analysisHtml}, #{stemText}, #{correct}, #{answerText}, #{status}, #{statusReason}, #{displayReady}, #{licenseTag}, #{batchId}, #{assetsJson})
